title: Flittermouse
summary: FLIT'TERMOUSE, noun [Flit, flitter and mouse.] A bat; an animal that has the fur of a mouse, and membranes which answer the purpose of wings, and enable the animal to sustain itself in a fluttering fl

inlines.v: FLIT'TERMOUSE, noun [Flit, flitter and mouse.] A bat; an animal that has the fur of a mouse, and membranes which answer the purpose of wings, and enable the animal to sustain itself in a fluttering flight.
